goal: Compare installed local models as coding agents on pinned, real Python repositories using identical prompts, tools, limits, and deterministic checks.

dimensions.quality: Weighted deterministic correctness across all applicable challenges.
dimensions.speed: Median end-to-end wall time and output tokens per second, reported separately from correctness.
dimensions.tools: Successful tool-call rate, retries, failures, and calls per solved task.
dimensions.reasoning: Scores on R05, R07, and R08, which require execution tracing, causal diagnosis, and boundary reasoning.
dimensions.task_understanding: Scores on R01, R02, and R09 plus instruction compliance such as no-edit constraints.
dimensions.complex_coding: R10 end-to-end correctness with the public API and focused regressions preserved.

controls.judge_policy: Deterministic checks are authoritative. Any LLM judge score is advisory until a dated calibration artifact passes.

gates.mutation_sensitivity: Each injected bug must fail before repair and pass after repair
gates.coverage: Every completion-capable model gets all ten tasks; embedding-only models are explicitly not applicable
gates.reporting: Show coverage, errors, timeouts, token use, tool statistics, and per-category scores; never rank missing coverage as zero-quality
